title: Personal Injury Paralegal
description:
Personal Injury Paralegal

Bristol

Salary up to 30,000 DOE

Yolk Recruitment is working with a national law firm looking to recruit a Personal Injury Paralegal to join its Serious & Catastrophic Injury team in Bristol.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with claimant Personal Injury experience who wants to develop their exposure to more complex, high-value injury work.

Rather than being expected to independently manage a significant caseload, you will work closely with senior members of the team, assisting with serious and catastrophic injury claims. The position would particularly suit a Paralegal, Legal Assistant or PI Case Handler looking to build their technical knowledge while learning directly from experienced serious injury specialists.

The role offers hybrid working, with two days per week in the Bristol office and three days working from home.

This is what you will be doing

As a Personal Injury Paralegal, your duties and responsibilities will include:
- Assisting senior case handlers with serious and catastrophic personal injury claims.
- Helping with the day-to-day progression and organisation of complex PI files.
- Collating medical records, evidence relating to liability and evidence supporting uninsured losses.
- Organising client and expert meetings and conferences with Counsel.
- Liaising with clients, insurers, expert witnesses, solicitors and other parties.
- Maintaining accurate case records and ensuring matters are progressed in line with relevant service standards.
- Participating in regular case and risk assessment meetings.

The experience you will bring to the team

You will bring the following experience to the Personal Injury team:
- Previous experience within claimant Personal Injury, either handling claims or assisting with a PI caseload.
- Experience using a legal case management system.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- A good approach to client care.
- An interest in developing your knowledge of serious and catastrophic injury work.

Previous litigation experience and experience using bundling software would be advantageous but aren't essential.

This is what you will get in return
- Salary up to 30,000 depending on experience.
- Hybrid working with only two days per week required in the Bristol office.
- Exposure to serious and catastrophic Personal Injury work.
- The opportunity to work closely with experienced senior case handlers.
- Training, development and routes towards further legal qualification.
- Annual leave and employee welfare benefits.
- Health cash plan and gym/lifestyle benefits.
- Employee recognition and referral schemes.
- A genuine opportunity to broaden your technical Personal Injury experience.

Are you up to the challenge?

If you're a Personal Injury Paralegal ready to take the next step in your career, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today or get in touch to find out more. All enquiries will be handled in the strictest confidence by Yolk Recruitment. title: IP Records Administrator / Records Paralegal
company: The Law Support Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Records Administrator / IP Paralegal

The Opportunity

Our client, a well-established intellectual property firm, is looking for a detail-driven Records Administrator / Paralegal to join its busy formalities team. This role would suit an experienced IP records professional who enjoys accuracy, structure and working to strict deadlines. You'll support patent, design and trade mark matters from start to finish, keeping case records accurate and working closely with clients, fee earners and overseas associates. This position is full time hybrid, offering 40% remote working.

What You'll Be Doing
- Managing formalities across patent, design and trade mark applications, including filings, completion reminders, official communications, publications, fee payments, grants and certified copies
- Handling incoming post and electronic correspondence from clients and foreign associates, and recording deadlines and actions on the IP management system
- Identifying due dates in incoming correspondence and diarising them accurately
- Reviewing outgoing correspondence and updating case records to match
- Opening new case records from client instructions, checking data against online databases such as EPOLine, diarising deadlines and acknowledging instructions
- Recording filing details and checking them against filing receipts, arranging corrections where needed
- Updating case status as matters progress, including publication, grant or registration, oppositions, refusals, revocations and official actions
- Producing and sending standard correspondence related to the role
- Monitoring the daily critical deadlines list so fee earners are aware of same-day actions
- Taking on other tasks as needed to support the team

About You
- Highly organised, motivated and efficient
- Confident and self-assured
- Exceptional attention to detail, with accuracy maintained under pressure
- Able to multi-task and prioritise against strict legal deadlines
- Works well independently while also being a supportive, approachable team player
- Strong written and verbal communication skills at all levels

Desirable
- Experience using Inprotech or a similar IP records system
- 3+ years in a records or IP department
- Sound knowledge of EP and UK patent and trade mark procedures
- CIPA Patent Paralegal Course and/or CITMA Trade Mark Administrators Course (desirable, not essential)

Interested?

If you have the IP records experience and the eye for detail this role demands, please apply with your CV for a confidential discussion.

title: Legal Personal Assistant
description:
Owen Reed is looking for a proactive and organised Legal Secretary to join the Employment team at a law firm in Bristol.

You will provide a high-quality and efficient secretarial service to a Partner, fee earners and a trainee solicitor. Reporting directly to the Secretarial Services Manager, you will manage your workload effectively, anticipate requirements and use your initiative to support the team.

Key Responsibilities
- Prepare, amend and format legal correspondence, agreements, court forms and other documentation, including Tribunal bundles.
- Manage diaries and emails for Partners and fee earners.
- Organise meetings, calls and travel arrangements, and process fee earner expenses.
- Liaise with courts and other third parties.
- Open new matters, draft retainer letters and monitor their progress through Partner signing, issue to clients and client approval.
- Maintain the Key Dates Tracker, monitoring important dates and liaising with the legal technology team.
- Prepare financial reports ahead of billing, support billing for specific clients and liaise with clients to obtain approval to bill.
- Coordinate workflow with the Document & Design Centre, Print Room and other support teams, ensuring work is returned within required timescales.
- Liaise with Business Development, Marketing, Events and Finance teams to support team-based activities.
- Work to strict deadlines and manage competing priorities effectively.
- Build positive and effective working relationships with colleagues at all levels.
- Provide support across practice groups when required.
- Assist with pitch documentation, particularly creating and formatting PowerPoint presentations.
- Manage HighQ sites, monitor document uploads and maintain accurate site records.
- Issue settlement agreements through DocuSign, monitor signing and provide progress updates.

Skills & Experience
- Previous secretarial experience within a law firm.
- A proactive and enthusiastic approach, with the ability to work independently and use your initiative.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Excellent client care skills and a professional approach.
- High levels of IT literacy, with the ability to learn new systems quickly.
- Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate work.
- Adaptability and the ability to respond positively to change.

title: Personal Injury Paralegal (Remote)
description:
CRA Consulting is working in partnership with a well-established legal services organisation to appoint an experienced Paralegal to its expanding Personal Injury department. This is a fantastic opportunity for a claimant PI professional with a solid background in Road Traffic Accident litigation, who is confident managing their own Fast Track caseload and has a thorough understanding of the MOJ Portal.

You will be responsible for progressing a varied caseload of non-infant RTA matters, taking ownership of files from initial instruction through to settlement. The role offers the chance to utilise your existing technical knowledge, develop your litigation experience and become part of an established team with continued growth plans.

The Opportunity

Joining an experienced Personal Injury team, you will handle your own caseload of Fast Track RTA claims, ensuring matters are progressed proactively, efficiently and in accordance with the relevant legal procedures.
The position will involve a combination of case management, legal drafting, evidence assessment and negotiation, with a strong focus on achieving positive outcomes for clients.
Key duties will include:
- Taking ownership of a caseload of non-infant Fast Track RTA claims.
- Managing claims through the MOJ Portal and subsequent litigation stages where necessary.
- Investigating liability and assessing issues surrounding causation and quantum.
- Reviewing medical reports, witness evidence and other relevant documentation.
- Identifying evidential requirements and taking appropriate steps to progress claims.
- Drafting legal correspondence, statements of case and other relevant documentation.
- Negotiating with insurers and opposing representatives to secure appropriate settlements.
- Keeping clients informed and providing a consistently high standard of service throughout the claims process.
- Monitoring key dates, court directions and procedural requirements.
- Maintaining accurate file records and ensuring compliance with internal procedures and regulatory standards.
- Working closely with colleagues to support the wider department and maintain efficient case progression.

What We're Looking For

We are interested in hearing from established claimant PI Fee Earners who have previous experience handling Fast Track RTA matters and are comfortable taking responsibility for their own files.
You should ideally bring:
- A proven background in claimant Road Traffic Accident litigation.
- Experience managing Fast Track RTA claims.
- A good working knowledge of the MOJ Portal and associated processes.
- The ability to independently progress claims and manage competing priorities.
- A sound understanding of personal injury litigation and court procedures.
- Strong legal drafting, negotiation and analytical skills.
- A client-focused approach, with confident communication skills.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to work to deadlines.
- A proactive and commercially aware approach to case management.
- Confidence using case management software and Microsoft Office.

The Benefits

This is a great opportunity to join an established legal services provider with an expanding Personal Injury offering, where you will have the support and resources to continue developing your career.
The package includes:
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
- A supportive and knowledgeable team environment.
- Ongoing training and opportunities to develop your technical expertise.
- Scope for career progression as the department continues to grow.
- The opportunity to take ownership of your own caseload and further develop your litigation experience.

Whether you're looking for a fresh challenge or simply interested in seeing what else is available, this could be an excellent next step for an experienced Fast Track RTA Fee Earner.

Interested?

If you have a background in claimant RTA work and would like to find out more, CRA Consulting would be happy to have a confidential conversation.
Get in touch today to discuss the opportunity further.
